summary: Timer Queue Management is a distinct session_skill operating at the animation_scheduling task_family with queue_management method_family. It addresses low-level timer lifecycle (schedule, restart, stop, flush) and high-resolution timing control—a different semantic capability from the peer candidates (transition orchestration, brush interaction, link generation) and existing skills (parallel HTTP fetch, thread pool setup). No existing skill covers timer queue management, and the peers operate at higher abstraction levels (DOM transitions, user interaction, visualization setup) rather than raw timer primitives.
